intro.headline: Meet Kathleen Boutté Foster
paragraphs: Kathleen Boutté Foster is the Chief Information Officer at the City of Sunnyvale. Kathleen and her team provide innovative technology solutions to the over 1,200 users across City Hall.

With the dedicated innovation funds in her budget, Kathleen leads initiatives that improve and modernize operations. To support this effort, she partnered with Madison AI to translate goals into operational impact.

props.title: Sunnyvale’s Search for a Solution
paragraphs: Managing a full-service city generates a massive volume of records and policies, and staff were spending valuable hours searching through these. Rather than enlisting an internet artificial intelligence tool, Sunnyvale searched for an enterprise framework that kept its public records secure.

By partnering with Madison AI, Sunnyvale deployed a platform trained on its own files and data, ensuring every output is safe and accurate. Following Madison AI’s in-depth, on-site training, user adoption surged dramatically.
Across three knowledge domains, 237 staff members integrated Madison AI into their daily research and document drafting workflows.

props.title: One City, Multi-Domain Excellence: Workflows Across Sunnyvale
paragraphs: To support a wide spectrum of municipal operations, Sunnyvale started with a Citywide model and later added Planning and Community Development models. The Citywide model handled 57.4% of activity, including policy research, budget data consolidation, and human resources inquiries. The Planning and Community Development models supported technical planning, permitting, and land-use analysis.

Usage climbed as time went on, reaching a 32% increase in monthly conversation volume. From drafting accessible communications to navigating complex public records research, Madison AI fits perfectly into Sunnyvale’s daily routine.

quote.text: With Madison AI, we are giving our staff a time-saving solution to directly and securely access Sunnyvale’s records. The AI models allow our team to cut through administrative noise, streamline data-driven decisions, and focus their energy on serving our community.

props.title: Staff time tied up in search and report assembly
props.intro: Sunnyvale faced increasing demands, with valuable staff capacity tied up in data discovery and report assembly.

items.title: Eliminating Delays
items.description: Navigating years of policies, contracts, and codes required hours of manual searching across disconnected systems.

items.title: Reporting Burden
items.description: The extensive research needed to draft staff reports pulled attention away from high-value work.

items.title: Isolated Institutional Knowledge
items.description: Critical context was scattered across archives, making information research time-consuming.

props.title: Three knowledge domains for one city

phases.title: Understanding Operational Friction
phases.description: Leadership identified high-friction administrative tasks across departments, including Public Records Act research, contract review, human resources policies, and staff report drafting.

phases.title: Identifying Appropriate Model Deployment
phases.description: Madison AI implemented distinct knowledge domains tailored to Sunnyvale’s operational structure.

phases.title: Data Integrity and Security
phases.description: The system was built securely around Sunnyvale’s data and records, ensuring answers are cited from approved sources.

phases.title: Staff Adoption
phases.description: The rollout saw significant uptake, covering parks, public works, finance, legal compliance, human resources, and planning. Madison AI trained Sunnyvale staff and implemented the Citywide and Community Development models.

phases.title: Expanding to Complex Workflows
phases.description: Sunnyvale expanded usage to high-leverage workflows, such as generating council-ready staff reports and executing policy and compliance analysis.

impact.title: Saving 2,178.5 Staff Hours
paragraphs: Sunnyvale’s partnership with Madison AI transformed how staff access institutional knowledge and complete daily tasks. In a single quarter, the platform recovered 2,178.5 hours of staff time, delivering an estimated $217,850 in quarterly ROI, while supporting 2,052 conversations across nine distinct subjects.

As one of the Bay Area’s most innovative cities, Sunnyvale prioritizes supporting its municipal workforce. By eliminating hours of tedious research and drafting, Madison AI enables planners, engineers, financial analysts, and administrators to refocus on community engagement and public projects.
The partnership between Madison AI and Sunnyvale demonstrates the power of collaboration in the public sector.
